item.title: Highland Jobs Looks for a Local Ambassador to Help Businesses Hire Locally
item.description: Highland Jobs is looking for a local ambassador to help businesses across Inverness and the surrounding area hire locally, offering a flexible, people focused role designed around real conversations, community connections and supporting the Highlands jobs market. The post Highland Jobs Looks for a Local Ambassador to Help Businesses Hire Locally appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Quiet Croft and Building Plot Near Dunvegan on Skye
item.description: Set near Dunvegan on the Isle of Skye, this decrofted building plot with adjoining croft land offers open views towards MacLeod’s Tables and planning permission in principle, creating a calm and considered starting point for building a home.The post A Quiet Croft and Building Plot Near Dunvegan on Skye appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Labour Broken Promises Leave Students Saddled With £76,400 Of Debt
item.description: New figures show students in England graduating with more than £35,000 extra debt compared to Scotland, prompting Stephen Flynn to warn that free university tuition is only secure under the SNP as tuition fees continue to rise south of the border.The post Labour Broken Promises Leave Students Saddled With £76,400 Of Debt appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Growing Scotland’s Entrepreneurial Economy
item.description: From new funding for young founders to continued support for startups and scaleups, Scotland’s draft Budget for 2026 to 27 sets out how record investment aims to strengthen entrepreneurship, widen participation, and help businesses grow and stay rooted across the country. The post Growing Scotland’s Entrepreneurial Economy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A New Suicide Prevention Plan Aims to Reach People Before Crisis Hits
item.description: Scotland’s new Suicide Prevention Action Plan for 2026 to 2029 sets out national priorities backed by increased funding, focusing on prevention, early intervention, tackling inequality, and ensuring compassionate support for individuals, families and communities affected by suicide.The post A New Suicide Prevention Plan Aims to Reach People Before Crisis Hits appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Rural Communities Urged to Fight for Fairer Banking Access
item.description: A Highlands MSP has launched a UK Parliament petition calling for fairer banking hub rules, warning that current criteria fail to reflect rural realities and risk leaving communities across the Highlands without access to vital financial services.The post Rural Communities Urged to Fight for Fairer Banking Access appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: How Business Gateway Helps Turn Ideas into Sustainable Scottish Businesses
item.description: From startup basics to digital marketing, finance, and growth strategy, Business Gateway offers free, practical support to help Scottish businesses start well, grow with confidence, and build sustainable futures across communities in the Highlands and beyond.The post How Business Gateway Helps Turn Ideas into Sustainable Scottish Businesses appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Roddick Welcomes Momentum on A9 Dualling at Slochd
item.description: Momentum is building on the A9 dualling programme as the Scottish Government confirms progress at Slochd, with new junctions for Aviemore and Carrbridge welcomed as a major step forward for road safety, connectivity, and the future of Highland transport.The post Roddick Welcomes Momentum on A9 Dualling at Slochd appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A First Birthday Worth Celebrating at EVAC North in Forres
item.description: Erskine Veterans Activity Centre North in Forres has marked its first anniversary with a celebration bringing together nearly 100 members, highlighting a year of community, support, and connection for veterans across Moray and the north of Scotland.The post A First Birthday Worth Celebrating at EVAC North in Forres appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Well Proportioned Family Home in Milton of Leys, Inverness
item.description: Set in Milton of Leys on the south side of Inverness, this well proportioned family home offers flexible living space, a private garden, and easy access to schools, amenities, and the city, making it a practical place to settle.The post A Well Proportioned Family Home in Milton of Leys, Inverness appeared first on The Highland Times.
